events.title: Taste the Mountain - Sip, Savour & Stay
events.description: Rainforest dinners, handcrafted spirits, flame-cooked feasts and sweeping valley views. This Tamborine Mountain escape is built for those who believe a great weekend should engage every sense. Three unhurried days where exceptional local hospitality and breathtaking hinterland scenery are always on the menu. Come for the food, stay for the feeling.

events.title: 2 Days of Meeting the Makers
events.description: Shake cocktails with a master distiller, watch the valley glow gold from an open-air concert, and end Saturday at a mountaintop dinner that exists for one night only. Sunday pedals gently between local makers before one last afternoon of botanical cocktails and edible floral bouquets.

events.title: Winter Harvest Weekend
events.description: This is how Eat Local Month finishes for 2026. With flavour and flair. A lavender terrace dinner at Kooroomba. A main street transformed into a festival of 60 producers. Fireworks over Kalbar. Line dancing at the Harvest Hoedown. Three days of the Scenic Rim at its most alive. Be right in the middle of it.
